title: hotfix: fix race in SLO enforcer during regional failover leading to excessive load-shedding
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Context: During a partial regional outage we observed the SLO enforcer enter a tight backoff loop while executing regional failover. The race between the failover coordinator and the per-region circuit-breaker state update caused transient double-counting of inflight request estimations which in turn triggered aggressive load-shedding and evicted healthy traffic from fallback regions.

Root cause: The per-region SLOEnforcer uses two asynchronous paths to update in-flight counters: (1) the coordinator issues a regional-failover transition which creates temporary forwarding rules and (2) the region-level circuit-breaker updates estimated inflight tokens when requests are re-routed. Under specific timing, the coordinator would re-route a batch while the circuit-breaker still held stale counters and then apply a second decrement, producing an inconsistent view that satisfied the tracker's trigger to shed load.

Fix: Make per-region counter updates atomic with the failover transition by introducing a short-lived region-lock and combining the coordinator's re-route and the circuit-breaker's counter adjustments into a single compare-and-swap (CAS) operation. Also add defensive validation that prevents the enforcer from applying more than one decrement per request-id. This PR includes: 1) region_lock in SLOEnforcer, 2) atomic update path for counter and routing state, 3) request-id guard for counter adjustments, 4) unit + integration test that reproduces the race window, 5) a canary rollout plan.

Testing & validation: Added unit tests that mock concurrent coordinator and circuit-breaker updates. Integration test uses the perf-canary harness to simulate a two-region failover with high QPS and verifies no excessive shedding and no negative counters. CI includes an extra long-running integration job (15m) that exercises the re-route path.

Rollout plan: Canary to 5% of traffic in us-west-2 for 1 hour with enhanced observability. If stable, 25% for 2 hours, then full rollout. Metrics to watch: region_inflight_diff, slo_enforcer_sheds, cb_trigger_rate, error_rate_5xx, and request-id-duplicate-events.

Monitoring & mitigations: Added an emergency kill-switch feature flag to bypass CAS path and revert to previous behavior for immediate rollback. We also added an alert on region_inflight_diff > 10 for more than 1 minute to catch regressions early.

Related: linear ENG-2108, ENG-2112. This was driven by an incident (INC-2026-0219) and coordinated with SRE on-call.
